Okay, so you're okay people saying mean things about you in public. So here's a scenario:

I can't comment on being from and 'exclusive' school as you have described, but I can make a statement on the opposite. My university is among the most diverse universities in the world. That being said, I can see no true benefit to the diversity everyone praises. In fact, I haven't even heard many valid arguments for such. Of course, it increases the chances that new ideas come up, but all the other arguments are only valid if diversity itself is in effect. It's like saying "We need to pay NASA because we need to explore space." Sure, but that argument depends on us needing to explore space. Likewise, "we need diversity because it helps us feel comfortable with many people" really only depends on diversity existing in the first place. At least space exploration has other arguments for it. So if you ask me, I can't see many good reasons for it at all.

Other than the more intellectual side, I have to say that I think some stereotypes exist for a reason. If an argument against democracy is a 5 minute conversation with the average voter, then surely the same with people not of your same ethnicity/race/culture has similar merit. I acknowledge the outliers, and I'll give them credit where it's due. But if you come across a bear in the woods you're not going to say "Hmm, maybe I'll give him a chance because I haven't met him yet." No, you'll probably run your ass off in fear. It's an extreme example, but when some groups sit around and do the things that only perpetuate their stereotypes and then expect to be taken seriously, it's a definite 'no' by my books.

And what really gets to me is this "variety of cultures" bullshit. When people mingle like diversity is supposed to cause, they don't retain their natural culture/pride/whatever. They assimilate and conform to a single culture. And so the people who would do very well for themselves are brought down and the people who should work their way up make no effort to do so. It's a classic case of "we can't make stupid people smarter so we'll just make smarter people stupid." I can't say that this is intentional, but it's definitely what is occurring on a macroscopic scale. Just look at Sweden currently, they're getting really fed up with this issue.

So call me a racist, or whatever you like, but I really wish I could just be in a place with exclusively my own people. If I wanted to see different cultures, I'd travel there.
